concept.title: Sports sessions and clubs
concept.shortdesc: Playing team and racket sports, bowls and multi-sport sessions, including football, basketball and sports club membership.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Sessions offering a mix of sports, games and active pastimes, including adapted and SEND sport.
: Becoming a member of a sports club or team and playing in its leagues, competitions or matches.
: Taking part in basketball and volleyball sessions, from taster and beginner sessions to training and open games.
: Regular weekly or monthly football sessions, including recreational, coaching, walking football and girls-only sessions.
: Taking part in football or soccer sessions, including free, skills-building and community-run sessions.
: Playing tennis, badminton, table tennis, squash and similar racket or hall sports, including club nights, tournaments and sports hall use.
: Playing or trying bowls, including crown green and short mat bowls, through taster sessions, lessons, social play and club teams.
